meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

copy.tagline: 用命令行发送短信、拨打电话并接收验证码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在命令行中完成短信和通话
copy.tagline_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and receive codes from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: Claude 会用沙箱里已配好的真实手机号替你发短信、拨 AI 语音电话，并等待接收对方回信或验证码。命令支持 --json，输出便于程序解析。
howto.when: 当你提到电话、短信、验证码等词，或要求给某人发短信、打电话、等验证码时触发；本次会话首次运行 dial 命令前也会先接管。

say.text: 帮我给 +14155550123 发条短信，内容是：包裹已发出。
say.note: 调用 dial message 发送 SMS

say.text: 打个电话给 +14155550123，问一下我的订单进度。
say.note: 调用 dial call 发起 AI 语音通话

say.text: 等对方发来的短信验证码，收到就告诉我。

howto.what_en: Claude can text, place AI voice calls, and wait for inbound texts or codes through a pre-provisioned phone number, using the dial CLI. Add --json for parseable output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention phones, SMS, calls, OTP, or 2FA; when you ask it to text, call, or wait for a code; or before the first dial command in a session.

say_en.text: Text +14155550123 and say the package has shipped.
say_en.note: Runs dial message to send an SMS

say_en.text: Call +14155550123 and ask about my order status.
say_en.note: Runs dial call to place an AI voice call

say_en.text: Wait for the SMS verification code and tell me what it is.
